player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in SimpleTak.
On the board, your stones appear as '{player_stone}' and your opponent's stones appear as '{opponent_stone}'.

On your turn, choose one empty cell (by its numbered index) and place your stone there.
For example, '[12]' places your stone in cell 12.

Your objective is to form a continuous path of your stones that connects two opposite edges of the board (top-to-bottom or left-to-right).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: अमान्य सेल नंबर {cell_num}. ० और {max_board_num} के बीच होना चाहिए.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: सेल {cell_num} पहिले से ही कब्जा कर लेले हई। एगो खाली सेल चुनें।

action.placement: प्लेयर {current_player_id} अपना सимвल ({symbol}) सेल {cell_num} में रख दिया है।

outcome.winner: प्लेयर {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') ने दो विपरीत किनारों को जोड़ दिया!
outcome.draw: बोर्ड भरल हइ. ई बराबरी के खेल हइ !
